results.name: Real member proof verifies
results.evidence: Generated and verified a Semaphore V4 Groth16 proof for one of three synthetic members.

results.name: Outsider rejected
results.evidence: A valid proof for an outsider-controlled group was rejected by the API.

results.name: Altered proof rejected
results.evidence: Mutating a curve point fails cryptographic verification.

results.name: Unauthorized root rejected
results.evidence: The server checks its authorized membership state.

results.name: Topic substitution rejected
results.evidence: Changing the topic invalidates the server-derived scope.

results.name: Ciphertext substitution rejected
results.evidence: The proof is bound to the exact encrypted report.

results.name: Case credential substitution rejected
results.evidence: An intercepted proof cannot be rebound to an attacker’s case credential.

results.name: Expired period rejected
results.evidence: Admission accepts only the active UTC month.

results.name: Unauthorized slot rejected
results.evidence: Only policy-authorized slots 0, 1 and 2 are accepted.

results.name: Identity fields rejected
results.evidence: Strict schemas reject extra identity fields in report requests.

results.name: Oversized request rejected
results.evidence: Oversized requests are rejected before cryptographic verification.

results.name: Concurrent duplicates: exactly one case
results.evidence: Two concurrent requests produced one case and one consumed nullifier.

results.name: Replay cannot disclose a case secret
results.evidence: Replaying acceptance creates no second case and returns no secret.

results.name: Same slot produces the same nullifier
results.evidence: A fresh valid proof in the same slot is atomically rejected; insertion rolls back.

results.name: Another topic has a distinct nullifier
results.evidence: Two authorized topics yield different nullifiers and both can be accepted.

results.name: Another authorized slot is accepted
results.evidence: A second authorized slot permits a legitimate additional report.

results.name: Only the intended reviewer decrypts
results.evidence: Correct recipient decrypts; unrelated recipient fails sealed-box authentication.

results.name: Modified ciphertext fails decryption
results.evidence: Ciphertext corruption is detected by authenticated encryption.

results.name: Unauthenticated reviewer denied
results.evidence: The API, not just the UI, enforces reviewer access.

results.name: Wrong case credential denied
results.evidence: Case access requires its own random secret.

results.name: Correct case credential accepted
results.evidence: The reporter follows up without institutional authentication.

results.name: Lost acceptance response can be recovered
results.evidence: A retained case secret and proof-bound nonce recover the original receipt.

results.name: Reviewer topic permissions enforced
results.evidence: A valid reviewer token alone does not authorize a case outside its permitted topics.

results.name: Status transitions are checked and audited
results.evidence: Skipping directly to resolution is rejected; triage writes an audit event atomically.

results.name: Encrypted two-way follow-up works
results.evidence: Each direction decrypts only with its recipient’s private key.

results.name: Receipt signature detects alteration
results.evidence: The Ed25519 receipt covers the case ID, commitment and acceptance time.

results.name: Encrypted backup restores; wrong password fails
results.evidence: AES-GCM backup authentication and password-derived decryption execute successfully.

results.name: Reporting records contain no member identity
results.evidence: Persisted report records contain ciphertext and per-case metadata, without membership secrets, commitments or plaintext.

results.name: Revocation invalidates old proofs
results.evidence: A signed new epoch is installed; all proofs against the old root are rejected.

results.name: Forged membership update rejected
results.evidence: A root update requires the enrollment authority’s valid signature.

results.name: Old signed root cannot be restored
results.evidence: Monotonic epochs reject a correctly signed but outdated snapshot.
